title: Implement LlmHttpClient shared HTTP helper
description:
Create the internal LlmHttpClient class in the cisharpai project that handles JSON serialization/deserialization for all providers:
- Constructor takes HttpClient and optional JsonSerializerOptions
- PostAsync<TRequest, TResponse> method for JSON POST requests
- Uses System.Text.Json with camelCase naming and WhenWritingNull ignore
- Stream-based deserialization for efficiency
- No resilience logic (handled by HttpClient pipeline)
Add NuGet dependencies: Microsoft.Extensions.Http, System.Text.Json
File: src/cisharpai/LlmHttpClient.cs
